title: All-Time Great Indian Action Films
intro: This list weights the quality of the action filmmaking itself, not simply whether the film is a masterpiece. Choreography, staging, scale, innovation, influence, adrenaline, characters and rewatchability all matter.

entries.why_it_ranks: The foundational Indian action-adventure. Its gunfights, train sequence, Gabbar Singh, Jai-Veeru partnership and enormous influence make it almost impossible to displace historically.
Indian spectacle filmmaking at its grandest. Rajamouli combines enormous battles with emotion so that the action carries dramatic weight rather than functioning merely as spectacle.
Perhaps the most audacious modern Indian action film. The interval sequence, animal attack, rescue sequences and climax demonstrate Rajamouli's extraordinary command of cinematic action.
Prashanth Neel pushes the mass-action grammar to its extreme. Yash's Rocky, sound design, editing and larger-than-life presentation created a genuine pan-Indian phenomenon.
Lokesh Kanagaraj combines a thriller structure with explosive action and three formidable screen presences in Kamal Haasan, Vijay Sethupathi and Fahadh Faasil.
One night, one desperate journey and almost no conventional commercial distractions. Lokesh constructs increasingly difficult action situations while keeping Dilli emotionally grounded.
More action-drama than nonstop action, but Amitabh Bachchan's Vijay helped redefine the Indian action hero. Its influence on everything that followed is enormous.
Shankar took Indian science-fiction action to a scale rarely attempted before. Rajinikanth's Chitti and the extraordinary robot-army climax remain landmark achievements.
One of India's strongest examples of pure close-quarters action filmmaking. Its confined train setting forces the choreography to become increasingly inventive, physical and brutal.
The film that established Rocky's mythology. Its elevation scenes, atmosphere, music and stylized violence significantly influenced subsequent Indian mass-action cinema.
Vijay and A.R. Murugadoss deliver an exceptionally efficient action-thriller. The sleeper-cell hunt remains one of Vijay's strongest action narratives.
Suriya's physical transformation and A.R. Murugadoss's revenge structure created a ferocious action drama with genuine emotional motivation.
Amitabh Bachchan's Vijay Dinanath Chauhan turned the gangster-revenge protagonist into an iconic Hindi-cinema character.
Rajamouli makes a housefly an action hero and somehow makes us believe it. The ingenuity of the miniature action situations deserves recognition alongside much bigger productions.
Kamal Haasan's elderly vigilante Senapathy combines Varma Kalai-inspired combat with Shankar's large-scale commercial filmmaking and a strong anti-corruption narrative.
A crucial step in Rajamouli's development toward Baahubali and RRR. The historical battle portions dramatically expanded expectations for Telugu action spectacle.
Tightly executed military action with strong sound design, controlled pacing and a convincing physical performance from Vicky Kaushal.
A hugely entertaining action film with energetic chase sequences, international locations and Suriya at his commercial-action best.
Vikram and Shankar combine psychological drama, vigilante action and enormous set pieces into a distinctly Indian blockbuster.
Early Rajamouli at his most ferocious. Prabhas's rise from oppressed refugee to protector provides some of 2000s Telugu cinema's defining mass-action moments.
Sunny Deol's rage, Rajkumar Santoshi's direction and a powerful revenge narrative made it one of the defining Hindi action films of the 1990s.
Mohanlal's Aadu Thoma is one of Malayalam cinema's iconic action characters. The violence works because it emerges from an exceptionally strong father-son drama.

The overall film may not rank among India's greatest, but Vidyut Jammwal's physical action absolutely does. For a list specifically celebrating action cinema, its practical stunt work deserves a place.
Prashanth Neel creates an oppressive fictional world and uses Prabhas's physical presence extremely effectively. The action is designed around anticipation and explosive payoff.
Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff give the film tremendous physical credibility, while its chases, fights and large-scale set pieces represent polished modern Bollywood action.
